items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: It wasn't Clarence? You say it was Spencer. ... Clarence lived out there. ... Clarence. He's the one who did all the booking. ... Clarence Profit. You want to get his records.

ctx.x: Yeah. He bought some property. Evidently, he had a little money. And he bought... He was going to try to set up a musicians' settlement, songwriters.
It wasn't Clarence? You say it was Spencer.
